howItWorks.title: How Nuvex works
howItWorks.subtitle: Finding the right fare or the right place shouldn't take hours of refreshing tabs. Here's how we do the watching for you.
howItWorks.step1_title: Search your route or a place
howItWorks.step1_description: Tell us where you're flying from and to, or what kind of place you're after, along with your budget and dates. We scan live fares and locations instantly.
howItWorks.step2_description: Once your search is saved, Nuvex keeps an eye on it. The moment a fare drops within your budget, you're the first to know.
howItWorks.step3_description: Get notified by email the instant a matching deal or place appears, so you can book or plan before it's gone.
howItWorks.cta_title: Ready to find your next trip?
howItWorks.cta_subtitle: Head back to search and set up your first price alert in under a minute.

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.section1_body: By accessing or using Nuvex, you agree to be bound by these Terms of Service. If you don't agree, please don't use the service.
terms.section2_body: Nuvex searches publicly available flight fare data and place/location data, and sends you email notifications when a fare matching your saved criteria becomes available. We are not a travel agency, airline, or booking platform — we do not process payments, issue tickets, or guarantee fare or listing accuracy at the time of booking.
terms.section3_body: Flight prices and place information change constantly and are controlled by airlines and third-party data providers. While we strive to surface accurate, up-to-date results, Nuvex cannot guarantee that a displayed price or listing will be available when you attempt to act on it elsewhere.
terms.section4_body: You agree to provide accurate information (such as your email address) when using our alert features, and not to misuse the service — including attempts to overload, scrape, or interfere with Nuvex's search infrastructure.
terms.section5_body: Nuvex is not responsible for any losses, missed fares, or booking issues that occur on third-party airline, place, or travel sites. Always verify final pricing and details directly with the provider before completing a purchase.
terms.section6_body: We may update these Terms of Service from time to time. Continued use of Nuvex after changes are posted constitutes acceptance of the revised terms.
terms.section7_body: Questions about these terms? Reach out to us through the contact details listed on our homepage.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.section1_body: When you use Nuvex's search and price-alert features, we collect the information you voluntarily provide — such as your email address, origin and destination cities, travel dates, place preferences, and budget.
privacy.section2_body: Your email address is used solely to send you fare-drop notifications for the routes you've searched. Your search criteria is stored so we can match future fares and places against your preferences and alert you when a match appears.
privacy.section3_body: Nuvex retrieves flight fare data, airport data, and place/location data from providers including SerpApi, AviationStack, Geoapify, and OpenStreetMap to power search results, arrivals/departures boards, and place discovery. We do not share your personal email address or search history with these providers beyond what's needed to perform the search itself.
privacy.section4_body: Search records and alert preferences are stored securely and used only to operate the price-alert feature. We do not sell, rent, or share your personal data with advertisers or unrelated third parties.
privacy.section5_body: Nuvex does not use tracking cookies for advertising purposes. Any technical data collected is used only to keep the service functioning correctly.
privacy.section6_body: You can stop receiving fare alerts at any time by no longer submitting new searches with your email address. If you'd like existing data removed, contact us using the details on our homepage.
privacy.section7_body: We may update this Privacy Policy periodically to reflect changes in how Nuvex operates. We'll post the updated date at the top of this page whenever changes are made.
